fact: The INS Annuaire statistique de la région de Kindia 2024, edition October 2025, publishes 2024 regional statistics drawn from sector administrative sources: school returns of the education ministry's Bureau de Stratégie et de Développement (pre-university, NAFA centres, technical training, higher education), health information (BSD santé/SNIS), ANASA agricultural data, employment agency AGUIPE records, the Caisse nationale de sécurité sociale and sport and culture BSDs.
title: Annuaire Statistique de la région de Kindia 2024
